source.type: Biography provided directly by Justin Martin

sections.heading: Growing Up Creative
paragraphs: Born in central California, Justin discovered his love for making things at an early age. His parents, both creatives in their own right, recognized his artistic inclinations and nurtured his interests through after-school classes and activities ranging from creative writing and painting to photography and beyond.

By age 11, Justin's family had relocated to Springfield, Missouri, which has been his home ever since. Around that time, he first gained access to a computer and dove into online content creation. He discovered YouTube while it was still in its infancy and became fascinated by the potential to create and share his own videos.

As he grew older, video production evolved from a hobby into a possible career. He shifted his focus from his YouTube channel to building skills for real-world projects and developed complementary interests in graphic and web design.
moments: Filming everything with a camera in hand.

sections.heading: Co-Founding a Video Production Company
paragraphs: During his senior year of high school, Justin began college early and studied electronic media production at Ozarks Technical Community College. There he met Matt McClelland, who became a lifelong creative collaborator and friend. They bonded over a shared creative vision and entrepreneurial aspirations.

Together they founded Film Appeal, which began as a full-service creative agency and later focused on corporate video production. Their work with a range of clients helped them grow as creatives and business owners while taking them on memorable adventures.
After three years, Justin and Matt amicably disbanded the business as Justin moved into graphic design full time.
moments: Capturing footage in new Film Appeal merchandise.

sections.heading: Pursuing a Path in Design
paragraphs: Justin joined Murney Associates, Realtors as a Creative Coordinator, providing design support for more than 500 real estate agents. At Murney, he developed design from a personal interest into a professional pursuit. He eventually became Marketing Director, led a small team, and streamlined the department's design and marketing processes.
Wanting to focus on brand design at a boutique agency, Justin joined Hook Creative as a Lead Designer in 2021. He worked with a talented team to build brand identities and design solutions.

His broader skill set opened new opportunities at Hook, and he moved into the Creative Marketing Director role, managing design and marketing retainer clients and helping strengthen Hook's marketing and positioning.

sections.heading: Personal Life
paragraphs: Outside work, Justin continues to pursue creative projects. He and his friend Matt co-founded Shuffle Quest, a YouTube channel about music facts and history. The channel has reached more than 15,000 subscribers and 11 million lifetime views.
Justin enjoys exploring Missouri's outdoors, including Ozarks backroads and small towns, hiking, kayaking, and fishing.

Justin and his girlfriend, Kayla, live in Springfield, Missouri, with their cats, Ollie and Possum. They enjoy caring for houseplants, styling their mid-century modern home, and experiencing the Ozarks.
fun_facts: Justin subscribes to minimalism and intentional living in his personal and professional life.
Justin and Kayla are avid LEGO collectors.
